title: Cape Town and Garden Route
coverAlt: Table Mountain seen from across the bay

gallery.alt: Table Mountain seen from across the bay
Coastal road on the Garden Route

overview: A week of mountains, ocean and open road. Four nights in Cape Town cover Table Mountain, Cape Point and the Winelands, then you drive the famous Garden Route to Knysna for lagoons, forests and whale-watching bays.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Cape Town
itinerary.description: Airport pick-up and transfer to your hotel at the V&A Waterfront.

itinerary.title: Table Mountain and city
itinerary.description: Cable car up Table Mountain, then the colourful Bo-Kaap and the Company's Garden.

itinerary.title: Cape Peninsula
itinerary.description: Chapman's Peak drive, Cape Point and the penguins at Boulders Beach.

itinerary.title: Winelands
itinerary.description: Wine and chocolate tastings in Stellenbosch and Franschhoek.
itinerary.meta: Meals: breakfast, lunch · Stay: 4-star hotel, Waterfront

itinerary.title: Garden Route drive
itinerary.description: Scenic drive east along the coast to Knysna.

itinerary.title: Knysna and Plettenberg Bay
itinerary.description: Lagoon cruise and a visit to Robberg Nature Reserve.

itinerary.title: Departure from George
itinerary.description: Short flight from George back via Johannesburg to Lagos.

included: 6 nights in 4-star hotels and lodges with breakfast
Private transfers and Garden Route driver
